messages.author: ea6c1b624cdb2dda
messages.subject: expressions in legend labels
parts:
Is it possible to include expressions in legend labels? I need to
italicize some of the words in my legends.

An expression can be included in the title:

p <- (ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=mpg,y=hp,colour=factor(cyl)))
+geom_point()
+scale_colour_manual(expression(italic('cyl')),
values=c('red','blue','green'),
breaks=c(4,6,8),
labels=c('four','six','eight'))
)
print(p)

but I get an error, " 'pairlist' object cannot be coerced to type
'double' ", when I include an expression in a label:

p <- (ggplot(mtcars, aes(x=mpg,y=hp,colour=factor(cyl)))
+geom_point()
+scale_colour_manual('cyl',
values=c('red','blue','green'),
breaks=c(4,6,8),
labels=c(expression(italic('four')),'six','eight'))
)
print(p)

Thanks,
John
